109.

If a master or person in charge of a
ship fails, without reasonable cause to
comply with section 348.

348 1[Penalty which may extend
to five lakh rupees]

349 Fine which may extend to
two hundred rupees.

350 Fine which may extend to
five hundred rupees.

five hundred rupees.
